POLICE DEPARTMENT - NATIONAL CAPITAL TERRITORY OF DELHI
POLICE STATION: HAUZ KHAS, NEW DELHI

STATEMENT OF WITNESS UNDER SECTION 161 Cr.P.C.
FIR No.: 0089/2023 dated 22-04-2023
Under Section: 379/356/506 IPC
Recorded On: 25-04-2023
Recorded By: Sub-Inspector Amit Kumar, Investigating Officer (IO)

Witness Particulars:
Name: Pradeep Malhotra, Age: 42 years
S/o: Late Shri K. L. Malhotra
Address: Flat 3B, Malviya Nagar, New Delhi
Occupation: Shop Owner (Malhotra General Store, Green Park Market)
Role: Independent Eye Witness (Gawah)

Bayan / Statement:
"Mera naam Pradeep Malhotra hai aur main Malviya Nagar mein rehta hoon. Main 20-04-2023 ko shaam lagbhag 6:30 PM baje Green Park main market mein apni dukaan ke bahar khada tha. Maine apni aankhon se dekha ki accused Sunil Gupta complainant Rajesh Verma ke paas aaya aur unke sath gali-galoch karne laga. Accused ne complainant ko zor se dhamki di aur bola ki 'agar 5 lakh rupaye ka payment kal tak nahi diya toh jaan se haath dhona padega'. Complainant dar gaya aur peechhe hatne laga. Usi dauran accused Sunil Gupta ne complainant ke haath se unka leather bag chheen liya jisme zaroori dastavej aur cash tha. Accused turant apni silver Honda City car mein baithkar Hauz Khas market ki taraf bhaag gaya. Maine complainant ki madad ki aur turant police helpline 112 par call kiya. Yeh bayaan maine Police Officer Amit Kumar ko bina kisi dabaav ya darr ke sachha diya hai."

Recorded by:
(Amit Kumar, SI)
IO / Police Station Hauz Khas
Date: 25-04-2023
